【文章标题】：QNAP Flaw Allows Attackers to Bypass Authentication
【文章摘要】：QNAP Systems released security patches for QVR firmware in legacy VioStor NVR systems, addressing two vulnerabilities: an improper authentication flaw (CVE-2025-52856) that allows unauthorized access, and a path traversal vulnerability (CVE-2025-52861) that can lead to unauthorized file access once admin access is gained. Both vulnerabilities are classified as "Important" severity.
